title: SCP Anomalies — Pokémon Edition Record
description: Schema for a Foundation-style anomalous Pokémon containment dossier.

description.description: General Foundation description of the anomaly.

redactionLevel.description: Overall document redaction severity; 0 means unredacted.

regionalDexNumber.description: Use null when the specimen has no recognized Pokédex designation.

measuredHeightMeters.description: Actual measured height when it differs from standard Pokédex dimensions.

measuredWeightKilograms.description: Actual measured weight when it differs from standard Pokédex dimensions.

summary.description: Brief summary of why the Pokémon is anomalous.
